A1.justification: Both complete 23-page PDFs describe the same DeepEDM research work. Text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendix A.1–A.7 are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original DeepEDM experiments on synthetic dynamical systems and real-world forecasting datasets, including ablations, noise robustness, and generalization analyses in Section 4 and the appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including forecasting comparisons, ablations, and robustness analyses in Section 4 and the appendix.

M1.justification: DeepEDM’s base predictor, time-delay embeddings, encoder, kernel regression, decoder, stacked blocks, gating, and training objective remain unchanged in Sections 3.2–3.3 and Appendix A.2.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Lorenz and Rössler regimes, ten real-world multivariate datasets, M4 univariate forecasting data, and noise and unseen-channel test scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the synthetic, benchmark, generalization, and appendix comparisons. Hankel-DMD is newly discussed as related work but is not added to any reported experimental comparison.

E3.justification: The main benchmark T = 2H protocol, lookback search, channel-held-out splits, synthetic evaluation procedures, metrics, and training settings are unchanged. No experimental protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the same component and loss ablations, lookback and embedding sensitivity studies, noise-robust neighbor retrieval, and unseen-series generalization analysis in Section 4.3 and Appendix A.5–A.7.

E5.justification: Five-seed standard deviations for the main results in Appendix A.6/Table 10 and three-seed ablation reporting in Tables 3 and 12 are unchanged.

E6.justification: The numerical entries, rankings, and reported experimental findings are unchanged throughout Tables 1–12 and the result plots. Experimental pages 6–9 and all appendix pages render identically across versions.

T1.justification: Theorem 3.1, its assumptions, the mathematical formulation, and Appendix A.1 definitions are unchanged. The added Takens–Koopman discussion summarizes prior research without introducing a formal result, proof, or derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction’s three contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about integrating EDM with deep learning, noise robustness, Transformer connections, and state-of-the-art forecasting. The related-work edits do not revise these main claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations of noise robustness, MAE performance, reconstruction requirements, and lookback sensitivity remain unchanged, as do the stated applicability qualifications and future directions. The new numerical-issues remark concerns prior Hankel-DMD research.

D1.justification: Appendix A.2 retains the same implementation, normalization, layer and block ranges, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, and training duration. The stated code-access link and synthetic-data generation details are also unchanged.

R1.justification: Sections 2.2–2.3 add four references and explain prior Takens–Koopman connections, Hankel-DMD, and its numerical issues. Section 2.4 removes the broad assertion that an end-to-end differentiable integration of dynamical systems theory and deep learning remains missing. This is a focused refinement of research positioning.

P1.justification: Sections 2.2–2.4 receive localized rewriting, an added paragraph, and a deleted research-gap statement. Minor punctuation and paragraph-formatting edits occur nearby; the overall narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Text reflow moves Section 2.4’s opening onto page 3, adjusts method-text breaks on pages 4–5, and redistributes references across pages 10–12. All figures and tables retain their content, captions, and displays.

improvement.justification: v2 provides more complete scholarly context by acknowledging prior Takens–Koopman connections and Hankel-DMD, while removing Section 2.4’s sweeping research-gap assertion. This makes the positioning more measured. The method, empirical evidence, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, so the overall quality gain is limited.
